summary: Provision timebound AI-safety audit workspace: Jira project + Confluence space + ephemeral Slack bridge with automated deprovisioning
description:
Issue summary:
Request from Internal Security (AI Safety) to provision a time-limited collaboration workspace for a third-party audit engagement. The workspace must include: a scoped Jira project for tracking audit findings, a Confluence space for evidence and findings storage with restricted view/edit permissions, and an ephemeral Slack channel bridge that includes auditors and scoped internal participants.

Impact:
This is an internal request for sensitive audit work; incorrect permissions or missing lifecycle automation would risk overexposure of audit artifacts or orphaned access. Need least-privilege access and automatic deprovisioning after the audit ends.

Requirements (requested):
- Jira project key: AUDAUDIT- (please provision with project key AUDAUDIT and issue type scheme aligned to existing internal-support templates).
- Confluence space: "AI Safety Audit - Q1 2026" with space key AS-AUD-Q1-26. Permissions: only group ai-safety-auditors, ai-safety-core, and selected engineering leads. No anonymous/shared links enabled.
- Slack: create private channel #audit-ai-safety-q1-2026 and a Slack guest invite link policy that expires. Create a small cross-org channel bridge that mirrors messages to #audit-bridge-external for auditors; bridge should redact attachments by default.
- Access: Sync access from LDAP group cn=ai-safety-auditors,ou=Groups,dc=redwood,dc=internal. Use SCIM provisioning for external audit guests with guest role and 30-day expiry.
- Automation: create a lifecycle automation that will: send 5-day warning to members, then remove external guests and archive Slack channel, lock Confluence space to read-only, and mark Jira project as read-only at end_date. Parameterize end_date at creation time.
- Audit logging: ensure admin audit logs are captured and a snapshot exported to S3 at project close.

Requested timeline:
Start: 2026-03-09
End (requested automatic deprovision): 2026-04-09
Need initial setup and access tests by 2026-03-12.

Stakeholders:
- Requestor: Lydia M. (AI Safety) - lydia.m@redwood.com
- Security reviewer: Dr. Priya Raman - priya.r@redwood.com
- Engineering liaison: Jonas Patel (Infra) - jonas.p@redwood.com

Attachments and references:
- Link to auditor NDA (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/SEC/Auditor+NDA+Q1-2026
- Runbook reference: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/OPS/ephemeral-workspace-lifecycle

Steps to reproduce / setup notes (what we expect from IT):
1) Create Jira project AUDAUDIT with permissions scheme cloned from INT-template-project (internal-support).
2) Create Confluence space AS-AUD-Q1-26 and apply permission groups. Disable public/shared export links.
3) Create private Slack channel and invite internal members. Coordinate SCIM invites for external auditors and set guest expiry to 30 days.
4) Deploy automation (via existing Workspace Lifecyle bot) to handle warnings and deprovisioning. Provide an admin toggle to extend end_date if justified.

Risk and mitigation:
- Risk: External guests retain access after audit -> Mitigation: enforce SCIM expiry + scripted checks and S3 export.
- Risk: Sensitive docs accidentally posted to public channels -> Mitigation: channel policy + bot that deletes link posts with external domains and flags to security channel.

Approval: Security approved to proceed pending IT confirmation of automation capability and PR review.

We can clone permission schemes and space templates but need to confirm Slack guest provisioning limits for external domains. Created initial automation script (repo: https://github.com/redwood-internal/workspace-lifecycle/pull/428) — PR opened for review. Requested review from Security and Infra on redaction rules.

2026-03-12 | Morgan Lee (IT): KMS integration added to PR; demo environment test passed. Preparing production provisioning on 2026-03-14 per requestor window. Posting final checklist to Security channel #sec-audits.
2026-03-14 | Aisha Karim (Requestor): Confirming start window is OK. Please ensure we get a read-only verification report after the archival step.
investigation_notes:
Design spike findings:
- Jira: can clone INT-template-project schema and set project lead to 'AI Safety'. Project key AUDAUDIT reserved.
- Confluence: space templates support space-level permission sets; need to disable 'Share' macro via space settings and enforce 'view-only' space permissions at deprovision.
- Slack: use SCIM provisioning for guest users; automatic expiry works but Slack Guest APIs rate-limit invites. For >10 external auditors we need staged invites. Bridge: use existing bridge-bot but add 'strip_attachments' flag to prevent file mirroring.
- Automation: existing workspace-lifecycle repo supports scheduled archive and warning emails; added KMS S3 export hook and admin-extend endpoint.
- Open questions: quota impact for SCIM invites; need confirmations from IT security to ensure KMS key policy allows workspace-lifecycle role to encrypt.
resolution: In progress — provisioning scheduled for 2026-03-14. Actions completed: Jira project template cloned and pre-created as AUDAUDIT (staged, permissions pending), Confluence space created in draft AS-AUD-Q1-26 with restricted preview, Slack channel #audit-ai-safety-q1-2026 created in pending state for guest invites. Automation PR (https://github.com/redwood-internal/workspace-lifecycle/pull/428) merged to staging with KMS S3 export changes; production rollout pending final security sign-off and rate-limit coordination with Slack. Next steps: complete guest invites, run verification of read-only mode, export initial audit snapshot to S3 with KMS.
notes: Please tag #sec-audits and #infra-ops during production rollout. Admin must confirm KMS alias policy before final export.
